texts.name: Velina
texts.biography: Velina is fascinated by fire, light, and the Sun. She longs to spread warmth and a radiance that cannot be extinguished. Other sorceresses don't understand her obsession with this, but they have often seen Velina eliminate dangerous opponents from combat by blinding them with her power.

specialty.description: Casts Blind with an increased effect depending on the hero's level compared to the target unit's level.
specialty.name: Blind
